messages:
lucy.sales: Heads-up-- FinEdge POC tomorrow. Security will only allow three fixed outbound IPs. Need a minimal plan and timeline we can share.

amo.solutions: Recommendation: short POC = Dedicated pool + NAT with 3 reserved static egress IPs. Provide those IPs for allowlisting.

ben.eng: Implementation notes: we can reserve 3 IPs and attach NAT to the pool. Staging same-day if infra free; production-grade NAT + TLS usually 24-48h.

lucy.sales: Can we do mTLS for the POC? They prefer mutual TLS.

amo.solutions: mTLS not default on Dedicated. We can enable client cert validation at the edge as an enterprise option; adds ~48h and they must provide certs. For POC sometimes we do a simple client cert acceptance.

ben.eng: IP rotation: we do not rotate static IPs automatically mid-POC. If they want rotation, they must support dynamic allowlist updates or accept a CIDR.

lucy.sales: Any fees to flag?

amo.solutions: There is a small setup fee + monthly IP surcharge. Sales-ops may waive setup fee for strategic/paid POCs. Looping in @alex for approval.

ben.eng: I'll create an infra ticket. Please add expected RPS and token volume so we size the pool.

sre-bot: Created INF-2301 for FinEdge POC (owner=ben.eng) ETA=2026-09-03.

lucy.sales: I'll add traffic estimates and certs (if they want mTLS) to INF-2301 and share the two test curl commands once IPs are ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
